about_the_game:
AsTroops – card-based space fleet combat game

🪐 About the Game

AsTroops is a roguelike, card-based space combat game set in a world besieged by a massive alien mothership and its relentless fleet.
You are humanity’s last commander — your mission: break the blockade and destroy the mothership.

Control your rocket in real-time battles. Maneuver through deadly alien zones, unleash your attacks, and outsmart your enemies.
You’re not alone anymore: summon your own fleet of allied ships and command them in tactical formation.

Build your deck of weapon cards — featuring machine gun, rocket launcher, and electric weapon types, each with unique power and effects.
Machine gun cards provide rapid fire, rocket launcher cards deal explosive damage, and electric cards disrupt enemy systems.
Combine them strategically to dominate alien squadrons.

Each mission is different — every mistake is a lesson, every victory brings you closer to freedom.
AsTroops blends real-time action, fleet strategy, and card combat into a fast-paced space war experience.
Can you break the blockade?

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS *: Windows 7 / 8 / 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-2100 or equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 4000 or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 400 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible sound card
  • VR Support: Not supported
  • Additional Notes: Runs on low-end systems. For stable 30+ FPS during intense enemy waves, the listed specs are recommended.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 or AMD Ryzen 3
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 750 / AMD Radeon R7 250 or better
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible sound card
  • VR Support: Not supported
  • Additional Notes: Recommended for smooth 60+ FPS at higher resolutions and with visual effects enabled.

short_description: AsTroops is a roguelike card-based space combat game. Build your fleet, choose cards with machine gun, rocket, and electric weapons, and fight real-time battles to break the alien blockade.
supported_languages: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Simplified Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Polish, Portuguese - Portugal, Russian, Turkish
